notes.title: Advanced Dojo Minigame Difficulty Rebalancing
notes.content:
[h3]Dojo Minigame Difficulty[/h3]
We've gotten a new [b]negative review[/b] stating that the third difficulty of the dojo mini game is still too [b]unapproachable[/b] and [b]difficult[/b].

I just did another rebalancing of it, reducing difficulty and spacing out the timing of all the spawned logs.

[h3]New Update When?[/h3]

I know everyone of you is eagerly looking forward to [b]new content[/b]. We've made the conscious decision to focus on the remaining single player content of the game until 1.0 releases and thus stopped the plethora of content updates we've been releasing before, which we are still adhering to.

However, there's some [b]great news coming soon[/b], so look forward to that!

In the meantime there will be regular [b]bug patch fixes[/b] again of course, and [b]balancing patches[/b] like this one.

~ Julian

notes.title: Version 0.11.12 Slashes Onto Early Access
notes.content:
[h2]Advanced Woodcutting Challenge Difficulty[/h2]

The third difficulty of the woodcutting challenge in the Dojo has been unlocked!
Can you face off successfully against.. Lucky himself?!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44218979/8cd9b0e9b3840add42f1b1d90912d0d1cc08f6eb.gif[/img]


[h2]Logs Are Available In Maker Mode[/h2]

Finally, as long awaited, the logs from the woodcutting challenge  are now available in the dungeon maker.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44218979/34fb647befa87bb25a66323fcadec5f5ca81ba34.gif[/img]

They also are the first dungeon parts that are [b]locked[/b] by default, requiring you to unlock them first to use them.

This [b]lowers[/b] the [b]barrier of entrance[/b] dramatically to use the logs in maker mode, while still encouraging the player to go out of their way and explore Castle Town to find extra goodies.

The game also [b]explicitly[/b] tells you [b]how to unlock[/b] the given dungeon part to leave the player not guessing.

Many people have criticized the lack of visual distinction between pressed and locked pressure plates, which in many cases made it unintuitive to judge what state the plate is in.

You can also now toggle pressure plates state in the context menu.

notes.title: Version 0.11.11 Zooms Onto Early Access
notes.content:
[h2]Explaining the Update Drought[/h2]

I am very sorry for not having content updates the last few weeks! I was super busy upgrading the game from using [b]Unity's Built In Render Pipeline[/b] to their [b]Universal Render Pipeline[/b], which involved learning the new technology stack, rewriting all shaders and working around new limitations that the new pipeline enforces.

There's still a few visual quirks being worked out (like some things looking weird on the map screen and the water levels looking not quite right), but I'll have that sorted out in the next coming days.

This big refactor [b]reduces VRAM usage significantly[/b] and [b]optimizes draw calls[/b], which should make the game run better, especially on poor hardware, which was particularly important to me regarding porting to consoles later on.

These weeks have been very draining, as it was very tedious work with barely anything to show off.

Nevertheless, I hope the new content this update brings still excites all of you!
[b]We will be ramping up the amount of updates releasing again from now on again![/b]

The Telescope allows you to [b]slightly move the camera around[/b] (right stick/arrow keys by default!)
This can be useful to increase the range of sight the player has.

notes.content:
[h2]Peg & Hole[/h2]

The new [b]Peg[/b] and [b]Hole[/b] parts have arrived!

The peg is [b]pushable[/b] and you can put [b]objects on top[/b] of it. 
While on top, the carried object cannot be interacted with.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44218979/4da3048a7ecfba280b4e78657021e77550dbb7c3.gif[/img]

Three new signs have been added! A [b]question mark sign[/b], an [b]upward arrow sign[/b] and a [b]downward arrow sign[/b]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44218979/848906cb257a37c71e6004f2d5162441d20cfd07.png[/img]

You can now add a [b]shape/fragment[/b] to [b]minecarts[/b]! It will activate while the minecart is driving.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44218979/d1638a1837fe1dfaa51243db3a9c6ea46c99112d.gif[/img]

notes.title: Version 0.11.2.4: Changes To Mod Management & Uploads
notes.content:
Everyone loves modding! However, it's easy to break things if you're not cautious and change things like mod or asset IDs. It's also easy to glance over documentation.

Unfortunately, I had to deal with ID conflict issues in the past two days where mod creators have unknowingly broken their mod compatibility with older dungeons because they did not account for making a[i][/i]sset IDs backwards compatible.

This new update introduces two new safety measures which will prevent those mod compatibility issues in the future:

[h2]1. Manual Mod Version Increments[/h2]

The "Version" property in your Mod.yaml no longer defines what game version the user requires, but rather denotes the version of your mod.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44218979/1a6f43f2bf5d34363ea3e29876625a1f53d616ed.png[/img]
[i]It's recommend to start your mod at version "1.0.0.0" when you first upload it to the workshop.[/i]

If you want to update your mod after making changes, you have to manually increment the version number, let's say to "1.0.0.1". If you leave the mod version unchanged, the mod will not be updated in the workshop.

This change makes the mod creator's intent more clear and will also allow me to version mod's in the engine itself.

[h2]2. Asset Key Validation[/h2]

From now on, when uploading or updating a workshop mod, all asset keys are added to the workshop item's metadata.

Let's say you have a tree entity with the id "MyTree" and your mod ID is "MyCoolMod".
The mod asset reference of that asset is "MyCoolMod:MyTree", and the asset key would be "MyTree".

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44218979/75bab8e55826ef2f88fb70ea07432173dd6d022c.png[/img]
[i]The ID is optional, but it's recommended to explicitly set it, otherwise it uses the file name as the ID, which is more prone to accidental breaking.[/i]

When attempting to update a workshop mod, the game checks to see if all the asset keys that the metadata contains are still valid in your updated mod.

If that is not the case, that means you have made a breaking change which in theory would prevent users from loading their dungeons, in case they have used your mod in the past.

Generally I don't encourage changing IDs, however if you need to do so, make sure to use the Alias property to make your assets backwards compatible.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44218979/e2a6f785c75b18da9e9ac9c27ac8bb9726ab0bd0.png[/img]
[i]You can have as many aliases as you need.[/i]

[h3]Happy Modding![/h3]

notes.title: Version 0.11.2 Blasts Onto Early Access
notes.content:
[h2]Introducing The Phonograph[/h2]

Welcome the [b]Phonograph[/b]!

It allows you to [b]play a specified music track in a room[/b]. 
You can also add a [b]condition[/b] to it to conditionally play the music, like for a boss!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44218979/50bc00118328e5a2d540b1344b4bf6258bcab760.gif[/img]
[i]Choose from a large selection of tracks, including modded tracks.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44218979/9d1047922f8beba0242e4288165f116016cd0fa7.gif[/img]
[i]Play music conditionally![/i]

You can also make the [b]Phonograph[/b] invisible and add attachments to it, which allows you to fully hide it in your rooms.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44218979/3b20dc4972971024f745129f1bc6f16aee34a1d8.gif[/img]
[i]Out of sight, out of mind.[/i]

[h3]Tip[/h3]
[code]Until per-floor music selection is implemented, the way to add different music on some floors is to add a Phonograph into every room.[/code]


[h2]Add Conditions To Pets[/h2]

You can now add conditions to pets to make them appear and disappear.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44218979/7dd80451f9ad1db62624480b9b5c24779b5ced1e.gif[/img]
[i]Nini is in da house.[/i]

[h2]Generic Entity Type For Mods (Decor for example!)[/h2]

The workshop is full of decoration mods that use pets. It's a cool [b]workaround[/b], but [b]inefficient[/b] and [b]inflexible[/b], since pets have not been implemented with that in mind.

Introducing the new generic "Entity" type!

It allows you to specify if it's [b]solid[/b] or not, change its [b]size[/b] in maker mode (those entities are also [b]centerable[/b]!), and set a [b]sprite[/b] and [b]shadow[/b].

notes.title: Version 0.10.4 Adds Steam Workshop Support To Early Access
notes.content:
[h2]It's finally here![/h2]

The issues of Friday's update have all been addressed, I want to thank everyone for your understanding again!

The [b]Steam Workshop integration[/b] is done and you can now upload your custom character skins and pets to the Steam Workshop.

Let's go over some of the things you have to change with your mod to allow it to be uploadable.

[h3]1. Your Mod.yaml file now requires an Id property. [/h3]

This is required for you to allow changing your mod's name after the fact, if you want to adjust it. It's important to note that for that to work, the Id needs to be kept the same. 

If you change the Id of an already uploaded mod, it will upload a new one. 

You also want to make sure to make the Id quite unique, as you can't load multiple mods with the same ID. Imagine you used the ID "Link" for your mod, but it's likely other people would do that too. So you could use "Link_LA_Green", or even use an online GUID generator to generate a guaranteed unique series of characters.

All mods require to have this property added, otherwise the game will not load the mod.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44218979/a3bdbe59d23ce4b1b5a5862c7992240521c54f3c.png[/img]

[h3]2. Mod.yaml Author property[/h3]

This new property allows you to credit yourself in you wish to do so. It's however not required to be added.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44218979/a158422882a395db4b89f83a9eb8a4669ae34c0a.png[/img]

[h3]3. Upload To Workshop[/h3]

To upload your mod to the Steam Workshop, add the Upload property to your Mod.yaml file and set it to true.

If your mod has not been uploaded before, it will create a new entry on the workshop. If it has been uploaded, it will update the entry instead with the changes you made.

The upload happens automatically upon starting the game. So if you wish to upload, simply set the property to true and then restart the game.

[b]This is temporary, there will be a dedicated NPC for this. But we have to design that first![/b]

You can always set the property to false again if you wish to stop updating the mod. You can delete your mod from the Steam Workshop directly.

Note that it can take upwards of ten minutes for your mod to appear in the Workshop depending on your region.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44218979/160aac7b2a59926ed46f4320552494c125e2ab91.png[/img]

I recommend everyone to look at the sample mods for more information!

notes.title: Version 0.10.2 Is Modded Onto Early Access
notes.content:
Welcome to this week's update! Most of the team is back again and we are ready to roll.
Note that this week's update is still a bit smaller in scope since our artists only came back this week.

[h2]Adventure Together With Nini[/h2]

A new special pet has been introduced, Nini!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44218979/25a6cad22bcea2da1edb5d406396a9b8bdf571a9.png[/img]

How to get it is up to you to find out!

Nini has been added in honor of a very special person. I hope she will provide you with as much joy and love as she does to me,

[h2]Mod In Your Own Pets[/h2]

[b]Modding Quest Master[/b] is a very often requested feature, and I listened.

Starting today you can [b]mod in your own pets[/b].

I will be gradually [b]expanding the capabilities of the modding tools over the coming weeks and months[/b] and gauge interest.

Let's get into how easy it is to create your own pet.

[h3]1. Locate the Mods folder[/h3]

The first step is to locate the [b]Mods[/b] folder. It's part of the installation directory, which you can find my right-clicking the game within the Steam interface.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44218979/9fa73588882b59d9a7950fb17380f88c4627e232.png[/img]

[h3]2. Duplicate the Example Pet Mod[/h3]

You will notice a folder inside the Mods directory called [b]~Cojiro (Example Pet Mod)[/b].

This is a sample pet mod that I created, which simply creates a clone of the chicken pet and colors it blue.

To create your own pet, duplicate that folder and rename it to something you want.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44218979/f9ce758e584a8acddbef2d4effd1f1dc4f1a3c8b.png[/img]

[b]Note[/b]
[code]The tilde ~ character in front of the name makes the game ignore the folder. So for your own pet, do not use the tilde ~.[/code]

[h3]3. Modify The Pet Spritework To Your Liking[/h3]

You will see all necessary sprites inn the folder you just duplicated. Modify them however you want.

[h3]4. Optionally Adust The Pet Configuration[/h3]

You will see a [b]Cajiro.yaml[/b] file in that directory. This is what tells the game to produce the pet at runtime. It has a lot of documentation to get you started. If you wish to make changes to the animations of your pet or how it moves, feel free to modify it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44218979/1b73a292fcf62ebb4e73fb6f516e67926ec65723.png[/img]

[h3]5. Run The Game And Give Gabi A Visit[/h3]

If you did everything right, Gabi will show all your modded pets at the end of the list.
Enjoy your new custom pet!

notes.title: Quest Master Development Update
notes.content:
[b][h2]Hello, Quest Masters![/h2][/b]
We’re thrilled to share a major update on the development of Quest Master. Today, we’ll review the [b]revised roadmap[/b] we revealed with the latest theme update, [b]Coldfang Grotto[/b], and dive deeper into the upcoming [b]Single Player Campaign[/b], which we believe will be the crowning achievement of the game.

First, let’s address the big change: we’ve decided to target a [b]Spring 2025 release for the 1.0 launch[/b]. While delays are never easy, we’re confident this decision will ensure that Quest Master delivers on its full potential, combining everything we’ve built so far into an epic and polished experience.
Read on to see what’s coming next, why this extra time is essential, and what makes the Single Player Campaign such a special part of this journey.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44218979/5d29dbc8896286481df4a058ff199469a9346c14.png[/img]

[b][h2]Quest Master: Single Player Campaign:
The Next Chapter in Aetheria[/h2][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44218979/f9a0cb063363942655ea00ac0cf7b645c36a9115.gif[/img]
[b][h3]A Campaign Built with the Tools You Love[/h3][/b]
What makes this campaign truly special is that it’s being built using the same dungeon creation tools that YOU use to craft, share, and play dungeons. That means every dungeon in the campaign is a testament to the versatility of these tools, designed to inspire and empower your own creations.

To date, the Quest Master community has created over 3,500 user-made dungeons, and that number grows exponentially with each update. Your creativity has amazed and inspired us. In fact, as we’ve played your creations, [b]we’ve realized we need to up our game to ensure the Single Player Campaign delivers an experience that’s as creative and fulfilling as the best of yours[/b]!

[b][h3]An Expansive Adventure[/h3][/b]
The Single Player Campaign is not just a linear dungeon crawl—it’s a layered, immersive journey filled with surprises, evolving gameplay, and rich storytelling.

Explore Aetheria: Journey through magical dungeons and new areas, such as the grand Aetheria Castle, the bustling Adventurer’s Inn, the mysterious Quest Master’s Workshop, and more. Each location is designed to bring the kingdom of Aetheria, Castle Town, and all of its surroundings to life.

New Characters and Conflicts: Meet a cast of fascinating NPCs and face thrilling new challenges as you unravel the mysteries of Aetheria.

A Living, Breathing Castle Town: Watch the hub evolve as you progress through the campaign. NPCs, quests, and activities will grow in depth, connecting every aspect of the story.

We’re keeping much of the campaign under wraps to preserve the excitement of discovery, but rest assured—it’s not just a “six-dungeon game.” There are many surprises waiting to be uncovered!

[b][h3]Why the Delay to Spring 2025?[/h3][/b]
The extended timeline isn’t just about polish—it’s about building a campaign that does justice to the creativity and dedication of our players. Every gameplay mechanic, dungeon part, and asset we’ve developed so far ties into the campaign. By creating the campaign using the same tools available to you, we’re ensuring that Quest Master remains a platform for creativity long after the campaign is complete.

And most importantly, your creations have inspired us to push ourselves. You’ve set the bar high, and we’re determined to deliver a campaign that rises to meet it.

Remember that weekly updates still continue to happen. Delays in that sense are actually kind of beneficial -- it just means more content!

[b][h3]A Celebration of Creativity[/h3][/b]
This campaign is our love letter to the Quest Master community—a celebration of the creativity, exploration, and connection you’ve brought to the game. [b] Currently, we have over 3,500 Community Created Dungeons.[/b] We’re honored to share this journey with you and can’t wait for you to see what’s coming next.

As a reminder, the final major update to Quest Master in Steam Early Access arrived last week, introducing the 7th Unique Dungeon Theme, Coldfang Grotto.  You can snag [b]Quest Master at 25% off[/b] right now with the Steam Winter Sale as well!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2094070/Quest_Master/

Thank you for your patience and support. Together, we’re shaping something truly special, and we can’t wait to see Quest Master continue to grow as a staple in your game library for years to come.

notes.content:
[h2]Cake Day[/h2]

Hello everyone! I know I said there wouldn't be any more content updates this year, however, I decided to release a surprise update on my birthday today!

Let's get right into what's new.


[h2]Food Items[/h2]

There are nine new food items (as heart variants) that replenish various amounts of health, with the [b]Black Forest Cake Slice[/b] restoring all [b]ten[/b] hearts.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44218979/c943d41a5398a2c3f6f0dd3e6c0fbee6ff3b0561.png[/img]

Black Forest Cake, also called [b]Schwarzwälder Kirschtorte[/b] hier in Germany, is my favorite cake and I figured it would be appropriate to add it into game, especially because it's also been often requested to allow giving the player items that restore more than a single heart.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44218979/f15aba47af7b64e934ec58d48c98a554e386c2ea.png[/img]


[h2]Centering Dungeon Parts[/h2]

You can now [b]center[/b] most dungeon parts [b]off-grid[/b]. Excluded are parts like moving platforms which already are resizable or pushable blocks which require being aligned to the grid for their functionality.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44218979/bb704f5323127d950ce91dd20b071a150f65b72b.gif[/img]

This also translates to parts like doors.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44218979/8ab0e462bfe64a80570110ac262274cfb9569017.gif[/img]


[h2]Multicheckpoint[/h2]

The new Multicheckpoint variant is able to be [b]triggered as often as you want[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44218979/94d0722c7dc40fda8e06e1faa600ac71063f99a7.gif[/img]


[h2]Golden Clones[/h2]

The newest menace in town has arrived, [b]Golden Clones[/b]!
These golden fellas are Shadows, but even more on steroids.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44218979/3a89703249f705b43a007913c7f6947936798560.gif[/img]


[h2]Tooltip Tags[/h2]

The tooltips of dungeon parts have been refactored to contain [b]less text in favor of the new tags[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44218979/bdd5dd20db9376c416d6a1578278d8e07a59ab4b.png[/img]

This not only makes it easier at a glance to see properties of an object without reading through a wall of text, but it might also highlight things you previously did not know about certain parts.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44218979/0eb355c7090ae250ef31a51105c8c73d69849ef6.png[/img]

We'll continue to add more tags and refine the system.


[h2]Placement Layering[/h2]

Layering parts over each other has been [b]redone[/b] to rely [b]solely on the rendering order[/b]. This is way [b]more intuitive[/b], because what you see is what you get - as opposed to hard defined rules set by me that are not only annoying to maintain (and frankly, I quite often forget to) but they also limit things because I have to specify all interactions manually.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44218979/be5c96be232f8ff8dd6168b0b6f9b68d6458eac2.gif[/img]


[h2]Water Dash[/h2]

The new [b]water dash[/b] acts as the roll equivalent while swimming and diving. It allows you to move much [b]quicker[/b] in water, which is a hugely requested quality of life feature.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44218979/c56b3bad8fdc582b9ba7831f7d2331475393d7b5.gif[/img]

It's mapped to the same button as "Roll", which previously was used for diving. Dive is now bound by default to "Use Sword". In case you've previously already rebound Dive, make sure to double check your bindings to avoid conflicts.


[h2]NPC Icons[/h2]

Castle Town NPCs now show various symbols above their head when their dialogue is important.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44218979/328bac3c9b5a82f115658e32217ff2b8b64b303d.png[/img]

This should help guide new players and also provide more context when taking a stroll around Castle Town.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44218979/721757dea88e99934c85532e62de199519e67e0c.png[/img]


[h2]Show Bosses On Map With Compass[/h2]

The [b]compass[/b] now shows the location of [b]bosses[/b], indicated by a [b]skull[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44218979/2db0c597a592ae4ead45aa3b2ccc3c14a0603d39.png[/img]


[h2]Giant Ring Box[/h2]

If you've collected enough rings, give Gemini a visit! He might reward you with the Giant Ring Box, the next ring box upgrade which allows you to equip three rings at once.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44218979/c0e1e5580da1a18f484854872a747ed4174e9d7a.png[/img]

Of course, this ring box will, once given to you, also be available in maker mode for you to use inside your dungeons.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44218979/c75b7f6bfbb082975a6ecafbbfac1cb64eb586b1.png[/img]


[h2]Closing Thoughts[/h2]

I hope you're enjoying this update! This will however be the last update of 2024 for real, lol. 
[b]The entire Quest Master Team wishes everyone a happy new year 2025![/b]

notes.title: MAJOR UPDATE 0.10 | Coldfang Grotto Is F-F-Freezing Over Early Access
notes.content:
[h2]Enter Coldfang Grotto[/h2]

[b]Coldfang Grotto[/b] is the 7th dungeon theme that we are adding to Quest Master, and with it, we are shipping the [b]biggest content update that we have ever created[/b]!

Have a look at the trailer!

[previewyoutube=kjtnzsNlsac;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]Another Quick Disclaimer[/h3]

This update is [b]not[/b] 1.0.
1.0 will be released later next year.
There will still be weekly updates until 1.0 releases.

Let's get into the goodies!


[h2]Power Up With The Gauntlets[/h2]

The new gauntlet items increase your strength and allow you to interact with objects that previously have only been interactable in multiplayer, for example, pushing 2x2 or even 3x3 blocks!

There are two tiers of gauntlets, the [b]Silver Gauntlet[/b] and the [b]Golden Gauntlet[/b].

The silver tier increases your strength by one unit, allowing you to push 2x2 blocks or pull 2-tile wide pull levers, for example.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44218979/ccbff8d8d3bc88ac8de6a27bf4010c36174b06ec.gif[/img]

The golden tier, on the other hand, increases your strength by two units, allowing you to push even 3x3 blocks or pull 3-tile wide pull levers.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44218979/1e014219356e306ccdbfb291990bc957abd6f949.gif[/img]


[h2]Slide Around Ice Blocks[/h2]

The new Ice Block is a pushable block variant that, when pushed, slides over the floor until it hits a solid wall.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44218979/7ac736e76daf64013e4cc552a605ee5769e38c2a.gif[/img]

You can also [b]encase[/b] various objects, like [b]items or enemies[/b], [b]inside the block[/b]. These will spawn once you [b]melt[/b] the ice block, for example, by casting a [b]fire ball[/b] at it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44218979/43558a2340251c22b56a4fa2578bc6436a9649f9.gif[/img]

Ice Blocks will [b]freeze water underneath it[/b], allowing you to create [b]temporary paths over bodies of water[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44218979/8a64c5e0e02b3ccf33f779b6ec09ea3cca6bb7fe.gif[/img]


[h2]Slip On The Ice Tile[/h2]

The new ice tile makes you slip around when walking on it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44218979/2f0615ef052a51e60caf88606ec91762dc309a4e.gif[/img]

It also has an incredible, unique tiling interaction with holes where it shows icicles underneath!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44218979/75ffbcadeda2a27a10d6d54ef9c0ad96763da8e4.gif[/img]

Pushing regular blocks on ice will also behave like ice blocks, sliding until they hit a solid wall.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44218979/a0b9e07a91d8f40ab7f6b1c4115f389e7b128a65.gif[/img]


[h2]Spawn Ice Blocks With The Ice Rod[/h2]

The new [b]Ice Rod[/b] allows you to spawn a single block of ice, functioning similarly to the Cane of Somaria.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44218979/0c3c30c5b29f2ea76969a83ac3fb1976d2cbe401.gif[/img]

The spawned block can be pushed as many times as you want, and it can press pressure plates, for example.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44218979/3f2fe818d2709276f5177affba1423ad1da255d7.gif[/img]


[h2]Freeze Your Foes With The Ice Boomerang[/h2]

The new Ice Boomerang variant freezes enemies it hits.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44218979/f43e4b7c39c6b81d5c6929a71662448cae6217d1.gif[/img]

Frozen enemies can be moved onto pressure plates to press them, which is a unique new interaction tied to being [b]Frozen[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44218979/0f340df5cc36c41e51833e63b0d76c05bd22919c.gif[/img]

But not just enemies can be frozen. Even things like switches can be frozen to halt their progression temporarily. For example, you can activate linked switches with the ice boomerang to solve a puzzle you couldn't previously solve.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44218979/d2b8001080978ce1bc42a6ca6892ab7cff3dd03a.gif[/img]

Similarly to the Ice Block, the boomerang also creates temporary paths over bodies of water.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44218979/1debc1321afbd83d8550645ff3c4b01b4bc94d33.gif[/img]


[h2]Freezlide Enters The Battle[/h2]

A new enemy appears!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44218979/644d07dd8e904dd6814aa61e35e50d438b1b1b2e.gif[/img]
[i](Note: I'm wearing the Safe Ring, which halves my damage output)[/i]

Freezlide will slowly move toward the nearest player and bump them away, but when hit, it will start sliding around the room violently, freezing everything it touches.

It also creates temporary ice on water during that sliding state.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44218979/760a812ee47aa1d2afcc1c80883c8ec00078bdbe.gif[/img]


[h2]Freeze Objects In Maker Mode[/h2]

You can configure objects to be [b]eternally frozen[/b] from within maker mode. This requires the player to melt the object beforehand to interact with it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44218979/6b0ea6cd5c68d0c299c2ba63f0a9286c6bb92a15.gif[/img]

Most objects, like bridges, can be frozen, even things you might not expect, turning them into slippery surfaces.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44218979/3c2861e60ef4e192fbdb568e97b8fa7c00e3ce0f.gif[/img]


[h2]Get Frozen By The Ice Slumberwing[/h2]

The new Ice Slumberwing is a bat variant that freezes you when you touch it.
It deals with contact damage, so it's best to attack it with various options. Or avoid it at all costs.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44218979/72bfe0e70580b64b2548f93d515f3550e96c88e8.gif[/img]


[h2]Spectral & Ice Arrows[/h2]

Spectral and Ice Arrows have been added, which work just like you would imagine, cursing and freezing their targets, respectively.


[h2]Freezeflame Brazier & Lantern[/h2]

The new [b]Freezeflame Brazier[/b] is a unique type of torch that cannot be lit using regular lanterns. It must be lit using the [b]Freezeflame Lantern[/b], or other ice projectiles like the Ice Boomerang.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44218979/6c9c6557301a2b787e9de579299763345e19ea2d.gif[/img]


[h2]Ice Goozer & Goozling[/h2]

The new Ice Goozer and Goozling variants deal with freeze damage, causing you to get frozen in place when hit by them. Attacking regular slime with ice damage turns them into ice slimes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44218979/b073e57d1909a399329d7871f0bb3eb0f049081a.gif[/img]


[h2]Slippery Ice Platform[/h2]

A new moving platform variant has been added, the Ice Platform. It functions exactly like a regular moving platform however it is slippery.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44218979/41c99874d40512845b2c71d71d887a1efc866e91.gif[/img]


[h2]Get Smacked By Snowball[/h2]

The new snowball projectile is a Rock projectile variant that deals ice damage.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44218979/985fab98186ff05c0d14e597aefc208ab9f7b02f.gif[/img]


[h2]Spectral Goozer & Goozling[/h2]

Spectral slime variants have been added to fill the gap. Attacking regular slimes with spectral damage turns them into spectral slimes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44218979/857ab22f35d09a50e3b3bcbe95399b794cb65fe0.gif[/img]


[h2]Sunlight[/h2]

The Sunlight dungeon part allows you to melt any frozen object that it shines on. This has prominently been used in Minish Cap's Temple of Droplets to melt ice blocks; however, it can be used in Quest Master in many more ways.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44218979/0390c34623993912d100d86495a9bd423b2fb095.gif[/img]

It's important to note that the respective object has to be fully contained within the light to be melted.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44218979/1afab97b427871018ee0ebad2e3ab0270d4f6910.gif[/img]

Sunlight will also cause Lunarc to become vulnerable when he touches it. However, we are delegating that functionality to the upcoming [b]Mirror Update[/b].


[h2]Awaken The Dead With Tombstones[/h2]

Tombstones are a new type of pushable that can have a message you can read from the front and spawn an object when pushed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44218979/2db92d5b6b95af27a5a7e2ce18af426df9125939.gif[/img]


[h2]Get Creative With New Decor[/h2]

We've added a few new decorational dungeon parts to spice up your dungeon.


[h3]Rug[/h3]

The rug can be resized to any size and placed underneath other parts.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44218979/8c767fc043cb413ba90a334f63b63816d6f55bb6.png[/img]


[h3]Flower[/h3]

The flower is, well, very pretty.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44218979/3012c53b47deb791f103da1096ddb7c8ab8e9993.png[/img]


[h3]Hook[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44218979/5c75aeb0413164045a079508d889b0ab835cf417.png[/img]


[h3]Shield[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44218979/746d3aa7993b630a1c00dce84fdf0096a8833865.png[/img]


[h2]Quality of Life[/h2]

Below are a few of the changes that make the game experience better overall.


[h3]Rolling Spike Trap Turn Property[/h3]

You can now configure rolling spike traps to stop when reaching a wall. This can be useful for one-way paths, for example.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44218979/35a487fac6d8112347c3c9655968a18f9fc05ff5.gif[/img]


[h3]Elevate Fairies[/h3]

Fairies can now be elevated, requiring jumping to collect them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44218979/8167f42a8fb0ae177e34b04369a83378976a519a.png[/img]


[h3]Max Heart Limit Increased To 10[/h3]

The max heart limit has been increased to 10.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44218979/21865f45c9ba5aaaba9791fa72ca98006cc14f99.png[/img]


[h3]New Roll Break Animation[/h3]

The previous animation, like a wooden crate, felt very unpolished when rolling into a breakable.
We replaced it with a much snappier, less game-flow-breaking animation!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44218979/03c7b2998de7edead816e09a8b71cfcc97517b9f.gif[/img]

This change is versioned, meaning older dungeons still utilize the old animation.


[h3]UI Changes[/h3]

We've made a few tweaks to the play mode UI.

Firstly, [b]small keys no longer follow you around[/b]. They are now being displayed in each player's HUD. The following keys were kinda cool, but with the addition of pets and fairies already following, it was simply too much noise onscreen and sometimes was a detriment to readability.

Additionally, we tightened up the UI and made spacing dynamic to make it look cleaner.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44218979/c5d884a26d8ae8cb1ab243656dcd6d943e5d93c0.gif[/img]


[h3]Pets... Assemble[/h3]

And finally, your [b]collected pets[/b] now show up inside the [b]fenced area[/b] near Gabi!
Collect 'em all!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44218979/09adc474782cb34a6736aeda2a29a22c55f421a6.gif[/img]


[h2]What's Next?[/h2]

This is the [b]last update of 2024[/b], bug patches excluded. We are now going into holiday mode and will be resuming weekly updates starting in 2025.

We hope all of you will enjoy this chilling update and have amazing holidays and a great start into 2025!

Much love from the Quest Master Team.

Join our [url=discord.gg/invite/2AdAAthbKt][b]Discord[/b][/url]!
You can also follow us on [url=https://x.com/PlayQuestMaster][b]Twitter/X[/b][/url].

Below, we are sharing an updated roadmap to get y'all up to speed with the release schedule of Quest Master.

Everything beyond 1.0, of course, relies on the game selling decently so we can continue to fund the development. Quest Master will be [b]on sale[/b] with the [b]Steam Winter Sale from December 19 - January 2nd![/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2094070/Quest_Master/

notes.title: Update News
notes.content:
Hey everyone, Jeron here!

We’ve got an important announcement about the next big update for Quest Master. The newest dungeon theme—one that many of you have been speculating about—was originally planned to release today, Monday Dec 16th. However, we’ve decided to push the release to Wednesday, Dec 18th to finish preparing some press related items that are worth to include with the press release we are doing with the update, like the [b]updated roadmap[/b]!

Now, let’s address the big question we know many of you have been asking… and confirm what you’ve been guessing: it is the Ice Dungeon theme! We’re thrilled to officially announce [b]Coldfang Grotto[/b], the frosty new tile set for the Dungeon Maker. With this update, you’ll be able to craft, share, and play your own icy dungeons, complete with the chilling aesthetics and features you’d expect from a classic Ice Dungeon.

We also want to highlight the incredible music for Coldfang Grotto, composed by the one and only @Wayne | Composer. If you were a fan of Wayne’s fiery, dramatic score for Emberstone Quarry or the vibrant, adventurous music he created for Castle Town, then you’re in for a treat. His work for Coldfang Grotto is packed with atmosphere, mystery, and icy grandeur, and we’re so excited for you to hear it in all its chilling glory!

To help make the wait a little easier, we’re bringing not one but two exciting things to you on Monday:

[b]Friday’s Surprise Update[/b] is now coming [b]today[/b] as a little treat to start your week on a high note!

We’ll also be sharing [b]animated GIFs and details about Coldfang Grotto[/b] to give you an early look at the tools and features that will soon be in your hands.

We can’t wait to see what this community creates with Coldfang Grotto. Your talent and creativity continue to amaze and inspire us, and we’re confident this frosty theme will lead to some of your most imaginative and exciting dungeons yet.

Thank you for your patience, support, and enthusiasm—it’s what makes this community truly special. We’ll see you in [b]Coldfang Grotto on Wednesday[/b], and we’ll have plenty to share with you [b]later today[/b] to tide you over!

notes.title: Version 0.9.8 Is Grooving Onto Early Access
notes.content:
Hey [b]Quest Masters[/b]!

Jeron Moore here—Executive Producer at Apogee and Game Director for [i]Quest Master[/i]. Today, I’m thrilled to share an exciting update that will take your dungeon-making and adventuring experience to the next level: a major overhaul to [i]Quest Master[/i]’s music!

As you know, [i]Quest Master[/i] is still in Early Access, and we’ve been listening to your feedback as we continue building the game toward its 1.0 release. Before we unveil the final dungeon theme update in the coming weeks, we’re excited to introduce a big change to how the music sounds as you create and play through dungeons.

[h2]Musical Journey from Retro to Orchestral[/h2]

Since Early Access launched, [i]Quest Master[/i] has featured two soundscapes:
[list]
[*] [b]Maker Mode[/b]: Lush, detailed orchestral renditions of dungeon themes.
[*] [b]Play Mode[/b]: Nostalgic 16-bit, SNES-inspired renditions of the same music.
[/list]This dual-layered approach, where the music seamlessly transforms between modes, has been one of [i]Quest Master[/i]’s standout features. Unfortunately, certain tracks were impossible to listen to, as Play Mode featured exclusively chiptune music.

When starting the game for the first time now, you are given the option to choose between a [b]preferred style of music[/b]. Choose Chiptune to get the same experience a it has been so far. Choose Orchestral however, and the game will prioritize playing the orchestral versions of the soundtrack in places like the title screen, play mode, and even swap out fanfares like acquiring an item for the orchestral version.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44218979/597e75f78412a8f663df70b50b586acbfc1bafb2.png[/img]

For more [b]fine-grain control[/b], you can configure the music selection in a lot more detail in the [b]audio settings[/b] if you change your mind later!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44218979/0d8ef5e731035a4a04d1d9661e3caff5a2e89081.png[/img]

[h2]Orchestral Title Theme Showcase[/h2]

[previewyoutube=-jIe9PN7zAo;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Meet the Minds Behind the Music[/h2]

We’re incredibly proud of the composers who’ve brought [i]Quest Master[/i]’s soundtrack to life. Here’s a quick look at the talent behind the tunes:
[list]
[*] [b]Chipper Hammond[/b] (Los Angeles, CA): The creator of [i]Quest Master[/i]’s iconic main theme, Chipper has composed the music for Dewdrop Roots, Gustwind Palace, and more. Inspired by legends like Koji Kondo, Nobuo Uematsu, and John Williams, Chipper’s melodies are unforgettable. Learn more about Chipper and his work [url=https://www.chapmanhammondmusic.com/]here[/url]. 

[*] [b]Wayne Strange[/b] (New Jersey): Known for his work on Emberstone Quarry, the ambush battle music, and the regal themes of Castle Town and Castle Aetheria (currently under renovation)! Wayne’s compositions are rich with dynamic energy, drawing inspiration from the classics ([i]The Legend of Zelda[/i] and [i]Final Fantasy[/i]). You can explore Wayne’s music on Spotify [url=https://open.spotify.com/artist/4Zs6FNn99zk6k1aLdNfNWH?si=1A5nwkmOQqmFzLtH2i-AOg&nd=1&dlsi=5b96d56bfe2f4913]here[/url].

[*] [b]Tomas Palazzi[/b] (Venezuela): Composer for [i]Bread & Fred[/i] and [i]Littlelands[/i], Tomas’s music brings [i]Quest Master[/i]’s Sandswept Ruins to life with cinematic flair. Drawing from the spirit of traditional Egyptian music, his work blends exotic melodies with sweeping orchestral themes. Tomas has also crafted the charming themes for Lucky’s Locks and Gemini’s Shop (debuting soon!), adding depth and variety to Castle Town's soundscape. Discover more about Tomas and his work [url=https://tomaspalazzi.com/]here[/url].

[*] [b]Tim Stoney[/b] (London, England): The brilliant mind behind Deepcoral Cove’s haunting theme, Tim also composed the music for the [url=https://youtu.be/YDu-7EFRrb0]Early Access trailer[/url], and is leading the charge on the music for the Single Player Campaign, promising a rich and dynamic score. Tim is part of Fractal Edge Music, and you can explore more of their work [url=https://www.fractaledgemusic.com/]here[/url].

[*] [b]Brent Houston[/b] (Vav) (Mesa, AZ): Brent has created [i]Quest Master[/i]’s chiptune adaptations and SNES-inspired sound effects, bringing retro magic to every note. Check out more of Brent’s work [url=https://soundcloud.com/user-255042164]here[/url].
[/list]

[h2]Honoring the Past, Building the Future[/h2]

[i]Quest Master[/i] aspires to be more than just a Dungeon Maker. It’s a Zelda-like dungeon builder set in a living, breathing, entirely original world. Every dungeon you create, every story you explore, and every note you hear is part of Aetheria’s history.

Through the music, you’ll feel the pull of the ancient Aetherial Network, the threads of power that connect the land. You’ll hear the echoes of Castle Aetheria, the seat of the kingdom’s secrets. You’ll sense the presence of the ancient Aetherium and uncover clues to the past that ripple through the present.

When the Single Player Campaign launches with 1.0, you’ll join Lanze, Javelyn, and Shiv as they face a journey shaped by courage, sacrifice, and discovery. They’ll brave the depths of long-forgotten dungeons, unravel mysteries buried in time, and stand against a villain cloaked in shadow and deceit whose ambitions could shatter the balance of Aetheria itself.

This update marks a major step in making the world of Aetheria richer and more immersive than ever. Whether you’re creating your next masterpiece or diving into someone else’s dungeon, the music of [i]Quest Master[/i] will inspire every moment.

Thank you for being part of [i]Quest Master[/i]’s journey. The legacy of Aetheria—and this game—belongs to you.

Stay inspired,

Jeron Moore
Executive Producer / Game Director, [i]Quest Master[/i]
Apogee Entertainment

A new magic rod variant arrives, the [b]Spectral Rod[/b]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44218979/d7990dabe1e75d024c7ed86aa87a24e8d4807100.gif[/img]

If, however, you the player gets cursed, you are [b]blocked from using your sword[/b] for the duration of the curse.


[h2]Spectral Boomerang[/h2]

The [b]Spectral Boomerang[/b], similar to the spectral blast, curses objects it hits! It can of course also [b]reveal invisible objects[/b] in the radius of its spectral light, just like all spectral objects.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44218979/bd66a3c7ef946fc1b83651a428df5309fcd57b87.gif[/img]


[h2]Spectral Slumbering[/h2]

A new bat variant, the [b]Spectral Slumberwing[/b],  is a naturally menacing foe that will curse anyone it touches.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44218979/88ad4e780d2ce210bfba5bec9a838dafec4dd71e.gif[/img]
These otherworldly creatures don't play around.

notes.title: Version 0.9.6 Is Pasted Onto Early Access
notes.content:
[h2]Blueprints[/h2]

A new huge addition to the game, [b]blueprints[/b], are here!

[h3]Blue- what?[/h3]

Blueprints allow you to [b]save a selected area to disk[/b] (and Steam Cloud of course!), allowing you to [b]copy[/b] and [b]paste[/b] it whenever and wherever you want, in any dungeon!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44218979/628013b8da0d26ba4e80aca4dfb8a91cc06dde19.gif[/img]
It's as easy as pressing save!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44218979/6c894c8a56ea23e94f76b506ce3db3a2e44ba1c9.gif[/img]
Paste them anywhere!

[b]This way, you can reuse contraptions for example.[/b]

You can also [b]upload[/b] them for everyone to enjoy, similar to dungeons. Of course, blueprints need [b]no clear check[/b] though, which means their upload happens in seconds!

[h3]The Blueprint Browser[/h3]

The new [b]Blueprint Browser[/b] is the central hub where al the magic happens. Here you can browse through your own blueprints, search for online ones, and reuse your favorite blueprints!

You can also search by name, which works in all three tabs.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44218979/cabf5098f2ae4e4b628e55cbe935e89bdf49f2cf.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44218979/978e03c741846a3eb5887aea6a3ca2d4aa9ea906.png[/img]


[h3]Grid and Room Outlines[/h3]

To make room for the new blueprint browser, we removed the dedicated buttons to toggle the grid and room outlines.

These are now accessible in the settings menu, and you can also bind toggling them to a hotkey now. They are not bound by default.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44218979/5016974202cc3ca6eb2e00c9a4d7421aff54f018.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44218979/10fe29ad88317cb571473382b7dbefe7003dd91a.png[/img]


[h3]Quick Share[/h3]

In addition, you can also use the [b]CTRL+C[/b] and [b]CTRL+V[/b] shortcuts to both [b]copy[/b] and [b]paste[/b] selections in and from your system [b]clipboard[/b].

This means after copying a blueprint, you could paste it into [b]Discord[/b] for example, in case you want to quickly share a project you are working on!


[h2]Shadows Can Now Equip Rings[/h2]

[h3]The Ultimate Power[/h3]

You can now give [b]Shadows[/b] [b]Rings[/b]!

They can carry up to how many rings your current [b]Ring Box[/b] fits, so if you have the [b]Big Ring Box[/b], you can give each shadow a maximum of 2 rings at once.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44218979/87b6c1ac53a856e6b429eaa5f1c1b22af96e6b3a.gif[/img]

[h3]Always Access Rings In Part Book[/h3]

You now also don't need to use the Ringless tag to access the rings inside the part book to allow giving Shadows rings even without the tag. Note however that for collecting rings as the player, you still need the ringless tag of course.


[h2]Improvements To Searching For Dungeons By Name[/h2]

Some of you might have noticed that searching for a dungeon by its name was quite difficult in the past, as the dungeon browser returned way too many search results that didn't match up enough with what you were searching for.

I'm glad to report that this is now fixed, as it turned out to be a bug with the underlying mod.io API.

The search is now way more accurate and should help you find the dungeon you want.

In the following example I was searching for "Tower of Winds", and the game now solely returns 2 dungeons, perfectly matching with my query, whereas before it was returning 30+ pages of dungeons.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44218979/7fc376a8e78e4bbff45f599ae947fd54b86e3873.png[/img]


[h2]Retry From Checkpoint Hotkey[/h2]

You can now bind a key of your choice to retry from last checkpoint. it is not bound by default.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44218979/823a3445690551ca12b12d3c62eaa2661eae6428.png[/img]


[h2]File Location Updates[/h2]

In order to allow automatic file transfer from demo to full game and to allow unique save data per logged in steam user, I had to make certain accommodation to where user data is located.

The new locations for save files are as followed:

[h3]Windows[/h3]
[code]AppData/LocalLow/Apogee Entertainment/Quest Master/<STEAM_USER_ID>[/code]
[h3]Mac[/h3]
[code]~/Library/Application Support/Apogee Entertainment/Quest Master/<STEAM_USER_ID>[/code]
[h3]Linux[/h3]
[code]~/.config/unity3d/Apogee Entertainment/Quest Master/<STEAM_USER_ID>[/code]

While the old save data locations are still acknowledged by the game to support backwards compatibility, I encourage everyone to manually move over their files from the old location to the new one if possible.


[h2]New Anti-Piracy Measure[/h2]

A newly implemented anti-piracy measure prevents playing the game when it cannot establish a connection with the Steam client.

This does not mean that you cannot play offline (you absolutely can!), however if you try to execute the QuestsMaster.exe file standalone without Steam being open in the background (having Steam offline still works fine too), the game will shut down after the splash screen.

I'm honestly not sure how bad of an issue piracy is with Quest Master, but I figured I'd might as well add it.


[h2]Last Week Of The Halloween Event[/h2]

A friendly reminder that the Halloween Event ends on November 29th, so if you haven't grabbed the exclusive goodies yet, make sure to do so before the time runs out!

notes.title: Version 0.9.5 Launches Onto Early Access
notes.content:
[h2]The Daily Dungeon[/h2]

Many of you probably know of the [b]Featured Dungeons[/b] system.
Unfortunately, maintaining it is too much of a time investment for me, so I decided to implement a new type of community spotlight - the [b]Daily Dungeon[/b]!


[h3]The Daily What?[/h3]

Each [b]day[/b], a new [b]creator[/b] is chosen to have [b]one of their dungeons be featured[/b] on the latest [b]Daily Dungeon Board[/b] outside the workshop!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44218979/464ea870c7034565628acd0d37b1e357a9f3aa03.gif[/img]

Being featured as the Daily Dungeon is also rewarded with a [b]new badge[/b]!

We also made the change to [b]remove the silhouettes of badges that you have not claimed yet[/b], as several people have expressed distaste for fear of missing out in relation to badges that are no longer claimable, like the Demo badge.


[h2]Spectral Fire Bars[/h2]

This new variation of the fire bar will reveal invisible objects in its light radius.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44218979/d26067fc824af8502863745d0d82492662f9b7be.gif[/img]


[h2]Metal Fire Bars[/h2]

This new variation of the fire bar is substantial and does not deal damage. Instead, it pushes objects away!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44218979/b7bd042bef37dc52f51a93499ec8c7adc4dbc958.gif[/img]


[h2]Elevating Bats[/h2]

You can now make [b]bats[/b] [b]elevated[/b], requiring you to jump to reach them!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44218979/c753855b8bc6a378f95d4108e2cd0691d734bcb0.gif[/img]


[h2]Steam Cloud Now Synchronizes Your Created Dungeons[/h2]

As some of you might remember, we tried to implement a custom cloud system using mod.io because Steam Cloud refused to synchronize the dungeons that you make.

Unfortunately, after many weeks of tweaking it, we abandoned the idea because it didn't turn out well enough for our liking and always had residual issues.

Randomly, I tried configuring Steam Cloud to synchronize created dungeons again—and this time, it worked! I have no idea why since the configuration is exactly the same as last time. So, I assume Steam fixed an internal bug that prevented it before.

[b]Your created dungeons now synchronize using Steam Cloud[/b], so you can switch between PC and Steam Deck seamlessly and continue building your dungeons!


[h2]What's Next?[/h2]

This week's update was a bit smaller since we are hard at work on next week's update. And no, it won't be the next major update just yet. But we have something handy planned that you will enjoy immensely!

Have a friend interested in Quest Master?  You can save 10% on the Quest Master x Super Dungeon Maker Bundle!

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/41984/Super_Dungeon_Maker_x_Quest_Master/

If you haven't, join our [url=discord.gg/invite/2AdAAthbKt][b]Discord[/b][/url]!
You can also follow us on [url=https://x.com/PlayQuestMaster][b]Twitter/X[/b][/url].

As a reminder, the Halloween Limited Timed Event is active until November 30th, so you have half of a month to unlock the limited-time exclusive rewards in Quest Master!

Cheers!

notes.title: Version 0.9.4 Falls Onto Early Access
notes.content:
[h2]"One" Conditions[/h2]

A new set of conditions have been added for the case of "One!
For example, if JUST one (but not more than one) of a given shape is activated.

The logical operation equivalent is XOR, in case that's helpful for some!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44218979/c0a5bd6beba194d9a4e584b0bef582c821a67976.png[/img]
New exclusive or condition being shown In the context menu.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44218979/7b2f642298d88cd46b6a5771bc01d361b34481e8.gif[/img]
The chest will appear if only one of the switches is pressed.


[h2]Diggable Hole Variant: Bottomless Hole[/h2]

A variant of the [b]Diggable Hole[/b], the [b]Bottomless Hole[/b], has been added to the game!

Instead of being able to dig up an item for example, you can fall through the [b]Bottomless Hole[/b] after you dig it up!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44218979/1beec61cd35e609777c069d18de885c438f4d6b6.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44218979/df77240c17cb689cf5476c4a01ca6f73738c6022.gif[/img]
Of course, you can also fall into the floor below through it!


[h2]New Dungeon Feature Tag: Ringless[/h2]

[h3]Prevent Taking Rings Into Dungeons[/h3]

The new [b]Ringless[/b] feature tag makes the player start with no rings and no ring box when entering your dungeon.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44218979/a9a3e590643cbd5cbda6048b9f59b8ae7da683c4.png[/img]

You can use it to enforce a consistent gameplay experience if you don't want players to modify their experience through rings.

[h3]Place Rings and Ring Boxes As Rewards Inside Your Dungeon[/h3]

Additionally, with [b]Ringless[/b] enabled, you can place all [b]Rings[/b] and [b]Ring Boxes[/b] you have [b]unlocked[/b] so far in your dungeons!

You can use it for example as extra progression, or in shops to spice things up!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44218979/e6832203457cf11865b066518ed0c714e3fbec19.png[/img]
The Ringless tag is required to place rings.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44218979/2a86246a84a7f41e135617ce2583fc467eccfac6.png[/img]
All the rings and ring boxes you have unlocked are available to place.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44218979/319fc5f2bee27584b84b244308980d0f181f7b3c.gif[/img]
Collecting rings in play mode.


[h2]New Dungeon Feature Tag: Mapless[/h2]

New new [b]Mapless[/b] feature tag prevents you to look at the map before you have collected the item.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44218979/6e4acec547ba168aa02ce46215994826e695c451.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44218979/dd34b707ef710a1024bc1cad4b72ed621ffc1c88.png[/img]



[h2]New Dungeon Feature Tag: Permadeath[/h2]

The new [b]Permadeath[/b] feature tag makes it so [b]dying in multiplayer is permanent[/b]. Usually, dead players automatically review after a few seconds with a quarter of a heart.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44218979/e4eca7a4a969a6ba8a168cf4209f87e436f7f97e.png[/img]


[h2]Revive Players With The Coffin[/h2]

With the new [b]Permadeath[/b] tag, it was required to add a more [b]explicit[/b] way to revive players.
We took inspiration from games like Donkey Kong Country and Spelunky, and implemented the [b]Coffin[/b]!

They also work across rooms and floors!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44218979/ebb0873238550daeeacab5a7521f586a15ef817d.gif[/img]


[h2]New Dungeon Browser Tab: Played Dungeons[/h2]

You can now see a list of the dungeons that you have [b]played[/b] in the [b]Dungeon Browser[/b], sorted from newest to oldest.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44218979/5a16aeb21def66067c6c96728cfd528a0639ce9a.png[/img]


[h2]New Dungeon Browser Tab: Liked Dungeons[/h2]

You can now see a list of the dungeons that you have [b]liked[/b] in the [b]Dungeon Browser[/b], sorted from newest to oldest.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44218979/4c0bcf3c0d5eea25e5130ec616cd55fed9b9eccb.png[/img]


[h2]Disable Combat Music In The Settings[/h2]

One person raised distaste in the Combat Music that plays in rooms that use the Kill All Enemies Condition.

Unfortunately, because we don't have the budget to redo or make it based on the dungeon theme, I decided to add an option to simply disable it in the settings!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44218979/ae61428ddd7119261f0c30261580fdcdb49e32f9.png[/img]

notes.title: Version 0.9.3 Is H-H-Haunting Early Access
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=T_Rt4W4uVVA;full][/previewyoutube]


[h2]Welcome To Spooky Town[/h2]

[b]Halloween[/b] has reached [b]Castle Town[/b]!

Explore a beautifully frightening version of Castle Town during the [b]Halloween Event[/b], which will last up [b]until November 30th!
[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44218979/897ef391c0d2b05eca9fb5be55fc65c66594037d.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44218979/908b9a07bd0e141d9fe37245706fab8260383eb8.png[/img]

[h2][b]Enter Moonlight Brambles[/b][/h2]

Moonlight Brambles marks the newest dungeon theme we are bringing to Quest Master!

We revamped [b]Dewdrop Roots[/b] to make it more appropriate for Halloween, including gravestones, spiders, gargoyle statues, falling leaves, and more!

It also boasts a chilling rendition of Dewdrop Roots' OST.

The theme will be [b]available forever[/b], not tied to the Halloween Event itself!

[h2][b]From the Lore Master:[/b]
The Legend of Moonlight Brambles[/h2]

They say that deep within Aetheria lies a place untouched by the sun, where the moon never sets, casting a cold, silvery glow over an ancient forest known as Moonlight Brambles. Travelers whisper of a haunting beauty within its twisted trees and winding paths, but they warn that few who enter ever return the same—if they return at all. For as long as anyone can remember, Moonlight Brambles has been cloaked in mystery and dread, its roots steeped in the arcane and its air thick with the scent of earth and forgotten things.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44218979/0a630a34f6356f709fa6c25f4439a619a259eb05.png[/img]

The forest is littered with eerie remnants of a long past: skull torches with blue flames that flicker in the windless night, stone gargoyles that seem to watch with unblinking eyes, and cemetery headstones marked with names worn away by centuries. Some say these graves belong to ancient Aetherians who wandered too close to the realms of the dead, cursed to roam the brambles in search of rest they can never find. Phantom figures, known as the Lost Ones, are rumored to drift through the fog, their hollow eyes glinting like starlight, bound to this place by powerful forces beyond mortal understanding.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44218979/2595bdd8453aba832eb35957e4c9fa4f121604c6.png[/img]

In the deepest parts of Moonlight Brambles, giant spiders weave webs that shimmer under the moonlight, catching not just the unwary but whispers from the underworld itself. Ghostly Zorbs float between the twisted trees, their forms fading in and out like dying embers, guiding—or perhaps luring—the curious ever deeper. And then there are the pumpkins that grow wild here, twisted and gnarled, each with a leering face carved as if by invisible hands. Legends claim they were planted by a shadowy figure who once tried to claim the brambles as their own, and though the figure is long gone, the pumpkins remain, a mark of the forest's dark past.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44218979/c0d2bbf235e8699c8943f6f0e8daca22cc05d4f0.png[/img]

The Moonlight Brambles are more than just a forest—they are a threshold between the realms of the living and the dead, where magic runs wild, and the spirits of the past find no rest. Those who venture too close are warned: tread lightly and keep an eye on the path, for the forest has a way of closing in on those who dare disturb its ancient slumber.


[h2]Earn The Exclusive Halloween Badge[/h2]

Show everyone that you've been there!

Play Quest Master during the extraordinary [b]Halloween Event[/b] to earn a [b]time-exclusive[/b] name [b]badge[/b] that will show on your [b]user profile[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44218979/8772416f4f3710224536019fa0582a20bc66a9b5.png[/img]


[h2]Jack the Reaper[/h2]

Rumors are going around that Jack the Reaper supposedly shows up sometimes in Castle Town...
what horrors might be bring?

But be quick! He will unlikely persist after the [b]Halloween Event[/b] has ended.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44218979/e27c55ea255e97267a17bbccb69954cdba9e3a85.png[/img]


[h2]Logic Update[/h2]

As promised in last week's post, we are also shipping a major update to the conditions and logic!


[h3]Inverting Shapes[/h3]

Each [b]Shape[/b] can now be [b]inverted[/b]!

For example, rather than having the shape trigger when the enemy is [b]defeated[/b], it will trigger while it is [b]still alive[/b]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44218979/bd9e6f1b126f4443e436917cf4dff3a38d0cb896.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44218979/f9610d64c99fe9050b16b1de445cdc6013da12e3.gif[/img]
This chest will stay visible as long as all enemies are alive.

[h3]Condition Variants[/h3]

Most [b]Conditions[/b] have been given multiple [b]variants[/b] to enhance usability.

All Shape Conditions have options for checking for [b]Any[/b] or [b]None[/b] instead of just [b]All[/b] instances of a given shape.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44218979/27d3c1f67895a932051cf19271b981399673fa02.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44218979/033da319f1ffb58481aae1f0e8de085310a0963c.gif[/img]

notes.title: Version 0.9.1.0 Rises Onto Early Access
notes.content:
Welcome to this week's content update! It's already been one week since the latest major update, so let's get right into what's new!


[h2]Water Levels & Water Level Switch[/h2]

As promised, [b]Water Levels[/b] have been implemented!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44218979/b6653ec663982ab15c4accc129d7beb72f172f6d.gif[/img]
Water levels function [b]per floor[/b] and can be toggled using a [b]Water Level Switch[/b].


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44218979/d7e1bbc5788f90b3b9c324c4f84ba6cbdce78dc5.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44218979/81241f58285f293ad749cb30bea6414a123247e3.gif[/img]

One very important detail that was of upmost importance to me was making Water Levels highly performant. I'm delighted to report that using Water Levels has [b]no impact on performance at all[/b], which means you can use it as much as you want!


Due to how Water Levels had to be implemented upon all existing mechanics, some things don't work underwater yet, for example objects placed on top of moving platforms won't move with the platform if the water level is raised. I will alleviate those technical limitations in the coming days and will be rolling out these refactors afterwards!


[h2]Lava- and Mudfall[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44218979/8c86d11811efbb9c55fc6389cf7eaf6406400390.gif[/img]

Quest Master has been chosen by Dennsen86 for the annual Polaris event on Steam!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44218979/806aed90144406fc4e8eec775f81a5bf47a0ec42.gif[/img]

The Bubble entraps objects inside of it, similar to Gusts of Wind. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44218979/322a13416843292d1a6c23083c5c720fe3872254.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44218979/296a6d5bddb4ceb14a383a8b7fd4fe7ec4199732.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44218979/910307722b0ffeb66f0d0b848499242ef65629f7.gif[/img]


[h3]Water Pipe[/h3]

The new Water Pipe ejects a very strong stream of water that pushes objects away, similar to the Turbine. However, the Water Pipe's force cannot be counteracted, not even by running with the Hermes Boots.

The part book now has one more slot and some added height. With the change of showing the variant count in the book, it made sense to counteract the increased part height by making the book overall taller.

We've added a setting to disable the dialogues that appear when you collect items. Instead, items will be shown above the player's head. notes.title: Version 0.8.7 Swaps Onto Early Access
notes.content:
[h2]Introducing the Pouch![/h2]

Many people have requested being able to carry [b]multiple[/b] tools at once, so we've added the Pouch, which allows you to carry [b]two[/b] tools at once!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44218979/8755a168232efd81d4ce7d561078138fc3712d4a.png[/img]
Pouch get!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44218979/64864c56df4fb5078661a6d69de979a8ae52ca02.gif[/img]
Swap those tools!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44218979/c0bf00d58c4d6fc713615154b3038155ca99f7be.gif[/img]
Combining the boomerang with bombs allows for ultra-wide reach!

To explain why Quest Master does not offer tool switching in the inventory:
[olist]
[*] Having to open a menu dramatically hampers gameplay flow
[*] Bringing up menus in shared-screen multiplayer is incredibly annoying, as it locks out other players from controlling their character
[*] Being locked into a selection offers unique puzzle scenarios, e.g. having to strategically change tools or having to make a choice, or giving up your held tool to progress
[/olist]

Predominantly the [b]Four Swords[/b] series has started the trend of being locked into a single tool, but I hope the new Pouch will be of great use for y'all! There's some crazy item combinations, like fire rod and bombs, that open up the way for many new puzzles, previously only possible in multiplayer or with puppets!


[h2]Give the Propeller a spin![/h2]

Finally, a new [b]switch type[/b]!

The propeller is activated by [b]kinetic wind energy[/b] -- when wind touches it, it will start spinning. However, its [b]friction[/b] will cause it to slow down gradually, until it comes to a stop again.

This opens up many new possibilities for [b]timed operations[/b] without the use of dedicated shapes!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44218979/860bb8145d069acfe2ff969587b4af79b7fbdec8.gif[/img]
Turbines allow it to spin continuously!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44218979/eb5a375dca47ab8949be7b53de7f13f4d646aae1.gif[/img]
It will continue spinning until the Tornado vanishes!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44218979/04803c4fcf6b899ebec6d7c76921336724a2ee04.gif[/img]
Gusts of Wind will active them for short bursts!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44218979/7567bba769f61ca3ee36342831aa4dba838b734d.gif[/img]
They can also be deactivated with a condition!


[h2]What's Next?[/h2]

We are preparing hard for the upcoming next major content update releasing on [b]October 4th[/b], so mark you calendars! It will introduce many new game changing features that will elevate your dungeons to new levels, quite literally.

Next week is going to be a smaller update because of the preparations, so we are adding some content to Castle Town!


See your next Friday!

notes.title: Version 0.8.6 Is Crossing Onto Early Access
notes.content:
[h2]You Can Now Place Bridges Over Lowered Walls[/h2]

This has been requested for a long time and was very challenging to implement on a technical level, due to Quest Master not using real 3D physics. We delegated all week to implementing and playtesting the bridges so the new physics don't break existing mechanics!

You can connect the edges of lowered walls with bridges!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44218979/78d102c82b0e2d91ccc79aa106c43921acc12be2.png[/img]

All objects can move both under and on top of bridges.
Bridges can either be vertical or horizontal, depending on their placement.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44218979/d99ec0e4a5e2eb62f327a66a31d877f3e5503eb3.gif[/img]

Again, they were incredibly difficult to implement, and due to the 2D physics engine underneath, impose certain technical limitations, for example not being able to have doors underneath a bridge.

I am looking into possible solutions for this, but nothing is guaranteed. QM is stretching the boundaries of 2D physics so far already that it's essentially becoming a 3D game lol.

[h2]Tattle Totems Are Appearing In Castle Town[/h2]

These mysterious stone statues give you useful information and hints, for example [b]how long you have to wait before playing Lucky's Locks again[/b].

Their eye follows you around. Spooky!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44218979/3b3a8c84486adc3db5c82d04d5352e64c952b1aa.gif[/img]

They give you useful hints and information.

[h2]The Golden Goozer Has Been Added[/h2]

It's finally here.

[h2]You Can Now Lock The Cursor To The Game Window[/h2]

[h2]Changelog[/h2]

notes.title: Version 0.8.3 Teleports Onto Early Access
notes.content:
Welcome to this week's update!
As promised, we finally finished the new boss! So let's get right into what's new, shall we?


[h2]Zorbius Teleports Onto The Battlefield[/h2]

The new boss is called [b]Zorbius[/b]! He is a menacing wizard that can [b]teleport[/b] himself around the room and shoots [b]Energy Balls[/b] at the player.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44218979/1df683deea3d32b0d99a3406b8aeb34d98352145.png[/img]

He also can do a [b]charge attack[/b] and gets more difficult the lower his health gets.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44218979/8ccf25d0dedff595e140d59c00c32f66b6bc0894.png[/img]

Of course, you can configure the projectiles he shoots, so you can also make him shoot bombs for example for super chaos!

You can also make him invisible! Here is a silly quick attempt at recreating the Ganon boss fight from The Legend of Zelda on the NES with an invisible Zorbius.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44218979/8b5c291d01f056e45b1974f0bdfb196023f05ec6.png[/img]

[h2]Energy Balls[/h2]

Zorbius introduced the new Energy Ball projectile, which can be reflected with a spin attack. Use that to your advance in both combat and puzzles!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44218979/7518293ed90363ddb650068467790386ae65322d.png[/img]

He is currently missing some sounds, and a polished death animation, but we'll be finishing those off in the coming days!


[h2]Remote Bombs[/h2]

The remote bombs have no fuse... they are [b]detonated manually[/b]! This should be really useful in puzzles especially, so I can't wait to see what dungeons are being made with it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44218979/797c9da7b4dd720c202796d6d73a42aa464fb920.png[/img]


[h2]Entrances Got A Facelift[/h2]

The old entrance was super poorly made, so we decided to draw [b]all entrances custom[/b]!
Old dungeons using the previous entrance don't break, but using new entrances now will utilize this new one.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44218979/a4e239add87525d3c7f2534467281a6c04855032.png[/img]


[h2]Volume Scaling To 200%[/h2]

Some people have reported the game being a bit too quiet, so we added the ability to scale the volume to to 200% from the default 100%. I hope that helps!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44218979/d39c63fcfb719140d75c9eecf47f8fe04e733d55.png[/img]


[h2]Significant Performance Improvements[/h2]

Another week, another round of very major refactors that have significantly improved the game's performance in most areas this time.
Not only general gameplay and making rooms a lot less prone to lag with [b]many entities[/b], but also editing your dungeon is a lot more snappy now with large rooms, and especially using the [b]paint bucket[/b] tool.


[h2]Changes To How The Floor Below Is Shown[/h2]

We've made a pretty significant change to how the floor below (for example through a hole) is being rendered in the game.

Previously, It was using a perspective which made it shrink a bit, which looked cool, but was unintuitive while playing and also while designing the dungeon, as tiles didn't always line up 1:1.

This is now changed. The floor below is now rendered fully orthographically, meaning tiles will line up 1:1. This was not only done because of visuals, but also due to some technical reasons, which also makes the floor below rendering a lot more efficient now, essentially making it negligible.


[h2]What's Next[/h2]

Next week, we will be releasing the new Enemies that we have talked about before! So I hope you are all excited.

See you next week!
